notes.title: Version 1.0 Has Released!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that Relax In Space has released globally on Steam! Remember to try out the demo to make sure it runs on your system okay! The demo will give you a good idea on how performance will be and what the gameplay is like.

We would love to hear any suggestions or feedback from you in the Steam forums or on Discord!

Safe travels!

notes.title: Relax In Space Demo Released!
notes.content:
The day has finally come! A demo version of Relax In Space is now out and available for downloading. Please let us know if you run into any problems or bugs.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/V9lP68s.jpeg[/img]

We're working on a simultaneous demo release for Windows and Linux. If you have a Linux machine please try it out and let us know how it goes.

Have fun!

notes.title: [Important] Our Age Rating has Changed! Game demo is undergoing Steam Review!
notes.content:
While we have not radically shifted game play and content to exhibit mature elements, we have expanded the age rating on Steam to allow for more diverse pieces of content to be shown if applicable. This happened in large part of wanting to expand the content and nature of the game. While there are still levels in the game where you can relax in space, you can now walk around in a virtual museum that can update over time with new content.

If you have any questions about this or would like further clarification, please post a thread on the Steam forums and we'll be happy to answer your questions.

As a side note, we published an internal demo to Steam for review, they already came back with things for us to fix!

We're working out some kinks with the Menu system, once that is done a formal demo should be available for you to play!

Here's a preview of a black hole we've added to the full game 
[previewyoutube=AR-0-tpXzcQ;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AR-0-tpXzcQ[/previewyoutube]

Back to the bug fixing!

Warm Regards,
Lucky Cog Studios
